top_jobs.job: When I hear another founder lost their ad account and store to one phishing link, help me see which of our logins could be taken the same way and fix them this week, so we do not lose the store, the ads or a payout
top_jobs.metric: admin logins across store, ads, email, bank and domain with 2-step login on, weekly

top_jobs.job: When chargebacks jump or fake orders slip through, help me see the cause, the cost and the rule to change, so the processor does not hold payouts and good buyers still get through
top_jobs.metric: disputes as a share of orders, trailing 30 days, against the processor's warning line

top_jobs.job: When traffic and add to carts jump but orders do not, help me see how much is bots, fake clicks and fake sign-ups, so I do not scale spend or keep a page because of fake visitors
top_jobs.metric: share of sessions and add to carts scored as bots, weekly

top_jobs.job: When a data wipe, a hack or a peak week is coming, help me have backups, a tested plan and a short checklist, so we recover in hours, not weeks
top_jobs.metric: hours to restore a sample of products in the last test restore

top_jobs.job: When someone uses our name to cheat customers or a new script could read their cards, help me find it and shut it, so customers trust our store and our emails
top_jobs.metric: lookalike domains and fake ads using our brand found and taken down, weekly

jobs.job: Build the security folder: list every account (store, Meta Business, Google Ads, email tool, helpdesk, bank, payment processor, domain), its owner, its admins, 2-step status and recovery email and phone, with no passwords stored
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then every quarter and whenever an account is added

inputs.need: list of every business account
admin and user lists from each platform's settings page
roles and who sees what
team list

steps: List every account the business depends on, starting with the 8 that can stop sales
Export the admin and user list from each settings page
Record owner, admins, 2-step on or off, recovery email and phone, and whether it sits in a company account
Mark red: no 2-step, recovery on a personal email, or only 1 admin
Founder checks the list and names the owner for each red line
Put each red line on the board with a date this week
jobs.output: a security folder: 1 row per account with owner, admins, 2-step and recovery, and a red list with owners

watch.metric: critical accounts with 2-step on, 2 admins and a company recovery email

jobs.drives: no lost store, ad account or payout

jobs.job: Turn on 2-step login with an app or a key for every admin on the 8 critical accounts, and replace every shared admin login with a named login at the lowest role each person needs
jobs.trigger: this week, then for every new admin on the day they are added

inputs.need: red list from the security folder
an authenticator app on each admin's phone, or 2 hardware keys for the founder
who needs which role

steps: Start with store owner, Meta Business, domain, bank and payouts
Turn on 2-step with an app or key; drop SMS codes where the platform allows
Create a named login for each person who shared one, at the lowest role
Retire the shared login and store backup codes offline
Recount: 2-step share and shared logins left
jobs.output: every critical admin on 2-step, 0 shared logins, and backup codes stored offline

watch.metric: admin logins with 2-step on, and shared logins left

jobs.drives: account takeovers

jobs.job: Pull every staff member, agency, partner and app with access to store, Meta, Google, email and bank, and remove any unused in 60 days or tied to someone who left
jobs.trigger: monthly, and the day any agency or partner relationship ends

inputs.need: users and partner access per platform with last login
installed apps with data scopes
people and agencies who left

steps: Export users, partner businesses and apps with their last login or last use
Mark anyone unused in 60 days or no longer working with us
Remove or downgrade each, starting with Meta partner access and store staff
Remove apps with customer or order data that nobody uses, and rotate their keys
Log each removal in the security folder
jobs.output: a monthly stale access list and a removal log

watch.metric: accounts and partner access unused in 60 days

jobs.drives: outside people able to spend our money or see our customers

jobs.job: Write and test the Meta takeover plan: 2 backup admins, where the business verification lives, how to pause all spend in 5 minutes, and the Meta support path
jobs.trigger: once, then every 6 months

inputs.need: Meta Business admins and ad accounts
business verification documents
backup admins' names

steps: Confirm 2 trusted people are admins with 2-step on
File the verification documents and the support steps in the security folder
Write the 5 minute pause: who does it and from which login
Run a dry drill with a stopwatch; the Meta connection stays read only, a named person clicks
Fix any step that took too long
jobs.output: a 1 page Meta takeover plan tested once, with a time to pause

watch.metric: minutes to pause all spend in the last drill

jobs.drives: ad dollars lost in a takeover

jobs.job: Every morning compare live Meta ads, admins and daily spend against yesterday and the work board, and alert on any ad, spend jump or admin not made by a known person
jobs.trigger: daily at 7 am

inputs.need: live ads, ad sets, spend and account users
ad changes the team planned
store staff and settings changes, payout bank changes

steps: Pull yesterday's live ads, spend and admins
Diff against the day before
Match each new ad or admin to a board card or a named person
Alert the owner on any unmatched ad, admin, or spend 2x the 7 day average
Owner confirms or starts the takeover plan within 1 hour
jobs.output: a daily change check with unmatched items flagged, and hours to confirm each

watch.metric: unapproved ad spend and unknown admins on ad accounts

jobs.drives: dollars spent on ads we did not make

jobs.job: Show the team 4 real fake Meta policy emails, send 1 practice phishing email a quarter, and count who reports it instead of clicking
jobs.trigger: quarterly, and when a new person joins

inputs.need: real examples of fake Meta and Shopify emails
a free practice phishing tool or a hand-made test email
team list with emails

steps: Collect 4 fake emails the team got and mark the tells
Hold a 15 minute session: how to check a link, where to report
Send 1 practice email per quarter
Count reports and clicks per person
Rerun the session for anyone who clicked
jobs.output: a quarterly phishing score: reported, clicked, ignored

watch.metric: staff who report a practice phishing email instead of clicking

jobs.drives: account takeovers from one click

jobs.job: Compute disputes as a share of orders over the last 30 days each day, against the processor's warning line, split by reason, product and first-time buyer, with the month's cost in fees and lost goods
jobs.trigger: daily, and the day a processor warning email lands

inputs.need: disputes with reason code, amount and outcome
orders per day with customer and product
processor warning line (often 0.75 to 1 percent)
product cost and dispute fees

steps: Pull disputes and orders for the last 30 days
Compute the rate against the warning line and chart it daily
Split by reason code, product, first-time buyer and ship country
Name the top cause and the rule that would stop it
Total the month's cost: refunded value, goods, dispute fees
jobs.output: a dispute rate chart with the warning line, the top cause, and the monthly cost

watch.metric: disputes as a share of orders, trailing 30 days

jobs.drives: payouts held and fraud losses

jobs.job: Answer every not-received and not-as-described dispute within 3 days with tracking, the delivery scan, photos and the policy page, from a template per reason code, and track the win rate
jobs.trigger: within 3 days of each dispute opening

inputs.need: open disputes with reason code and deadline
tracking and delivery scans
tickets from the same customer
return and shipping policy text

steps: List open disputes by deadline
Pull tracking, delivery scan, customer tickets and the policy for each
Fill the template for the reason code
A person checks the proof and submits
Log the outcome and the win rate per reason
jobs.output: every dispute answered in time with proof, and a win rate per reason code

watch.metric: disputes answered in time and won

jobs.drives: money recovered from disputes

jobs.job: Hold orders over $300 from new customers with a freight forwarder address, a billing and shipping mismatch or 3 cards tried, review each before it ships, and each month check how many held orders were good buyers
jobs.trigger: on every order, reviewed within 4 working hours; rule check monthly

inputs.need: orders with risk score, address, billing, cards tried
known freight forwarder addresses
later disputes and repeat orders of held buyers

steps: Set the hold rule and route held orders to one reviewer
Reviewer checks email age, phone, social presence and past orders, then ships or cancels
Log the call per order
Monthly, count held orders later confirmed good (paid, no dispute, bought again) and confirmed fraud
Loosen the rule that blocked the most good orders, or tighten the one fraud passed
jobs.output: a daily hold queue, and a monthly table of good orders blocked against fraud stopped

watch.metric: orders held for risk and the share later confirmed as fraud

jobs.drives: fraud losses and good sales turned away

jobs.job: Check every discount code's use against its expected use each week, find codes posted on coupon sites, and cap or expire the leaked ones the same day
jobs.trigger: every Monday, and when one code passes 2x its expected use

inputs.need: orders by discount code
expected use per code: partner, creator, email, customer service
a check of the 5 big coupon sites for our brand

steps: Count orders per code this week against its expected use
Search coupon sites for our brand and list posted codes
Compute margin lost on each leaked code
Cap per customer, expire, or replace with single-use codes
Tell the partner whose code leaked
jobs.output: a leaked code list with margin lost and the action taken

watch.metric: orders on partner codes above expected use

jobs.drives: discount cost per order

jobs.job: List the top 1 percent of customers by returns and not-received claims cost, and set rules for them only, like signature on delivery or no free returns
jobs.trigger: monthly

inputs.need: orders, returns, refunds and claims per customer
tickets claiming not received
return cost per order

steps: Rank customers by return and claim cost over 12 months
Take the top 1 percent and check each by hand for honest bad luck
Tag the rest and set the rule for tagged customers only
Track their claim cost the next 3 months
jobs.output: a tagged list with the cost each customer drove and the rule applied

watch.metric: return and not-received claim cost from the top 1 percent of customers

jobs.drives: return and claim cost

jobs.job: Score last week's sessions and add to carts for bots (known crawlers, data center traffic, zero scroll, 1 second visits, add to cart with no page view) and show real conversion rate after removing them
jobs.trigger: every Monday, and whenever sessions jump 30 percent with flat orders

inputs.need: sessions, add to carts and orders by source, country and device
scroll and session length per visit
firewall or hosting logs with bot scores

steps: Pull sessions and add to carts by source, country, device and hour
Score each segment on the bot signs
A person checks the top 3 flagged segments in recordings
Show conversion rate and cost per session with and without bot segments
Mark any campaign or page whose win was mostly bots
jobs.output: a weekly bot share per source and page, and clean conversion rates

watch.metric: share of sessions and add to carts scored as bots

jobs.drives: budget and page calls made on real visitors

jobs.job: Watch small or failed payments per hour against normal, and when a card testing burst hits, turn on a checkout challenge, cancel the test orders and refund before fees stack up
jobs.trigger: hourly, with an alert at 5x the normal rate

inputs.need: payment attempts and failures per hour
orders under $5 and new accounts per hour
a checkout challenge or bot protection setting

steps: Set the normal rate of failed payments per hour from the last 30 days
Alert when the rate passes 5x
Turn on the challenge and block the source
Cancel test orders and log fees
Turn the challenge off 24 hours after the rate is normal
jobs.output: an hourly alert, a 1 page response, and the cost of each attack

watch.metric: small or failed payment attempts per hour against normal

jobs.drives: fees and processor alarms

jobs.job: Find paid clicks and email sign-ups with no engagement from flagged sources, remove the fake sign-ups from the list, block the source, and ask the ad platform for credits
jobs.trigger: every Monday

inputs.need: clicks and sessions by placement and region
sign-ups by source, time and domain
placement and click reports

steps: Pull clicks with sessions under 2 seconds by placement and region
Pull sign-ups in bursts from disposable domains or one source
Remove fake sign-ups and add a form challenge
Exclude bad placements and file for credits
Track the share each week
jobs.output: a list of fake clicks and sign-ups removed, exclusions added and credits claimed

watch.metric: share of paid clicks and sign-ups flagged as fake
watch.source: Google Ads, GA4 and email tool

jobs.drives: ad waste and email reach

jobs.job: Back up products, theme, pages, customers and orders every day, and each quarter restore 20 products to a copy store and time it
jobs.trigger: daily backups; restore drill quarterly and 3 weeks before a launch

inputs.need: a backup app for the store
a copy or development store
the list of what must come back first

steps: Install the backup app and check the first full backup
Pick 20 products, 2 pages and the theme to restore
Restore to the copy store and time it
Write the steps and file them in the security folder
Fix anything that did not come back
jobs.output: daily backups and a timed restore drill with written steps

watch.metric: hours to restore a sample of products in the last test restore

jobs.drives: hours of lost selling after a wipe

jobs.job: Write the 1 page incident plan (first 5 steps, who to call, how to pause ads and payouts, what to tell customers) and run a 30 minute drill with the peak checklist 3 weeks before Black Friday
jobs.trigger: once, then every 6 months and 3 weeks before each peak

inputs.need: security folder with owners and recovery paths
support contacts for store, processor, Meta, domain
peak dates
the last restore drill result

steps: Write the first 5 steps for takeover, data wipe, leak and site down
List who to call with numbers and support links
Add the peak checklist: 2-step, backups tested, fraud rules, traffic limits, stale access removed
Run a 30 minute drill with the team on one case
Log gaps and fix them before the peak
jobs.output: a 1 page incident plan, a passed peak checklist, and a drill date

watch.metric: days since the incident plan was last tested, and peak checks passed

jobs.drives: revenue lost in the best week of the year

jobs.job: Check each week that no browser or search engine marks the site unsafe, that the certificate is valid, and that the domain is locked and on auto-renew in a company account
jobs.trigger: weekly, and the day a renewal email looks odd

inputs.need: Search Console security issues
domain registrar lock, auto-renew and owner
certificate expiry date

steps: Read the Search Console security report and a Safe Browsing check
Check the certificate end date
Check the domain is locked, on auto-renew, paid by a company card and held in a company account
Alert and fix any fail the same day
jobs.output: a weekly pass or fail on 4 checks with an owner for any fail

watch.metric: days flagged as unsafe, and domains locked and on auto-renew

jobs.drives: days the store is dark or flagged

jobs.job: Search each week for lookalike domains and fake ads using our brand name, logo or products, and file takedowns with the registrar and Meta
jobs.trigger: weekly, and the day a customer asks about an order we never took

inputs.need: our brand name and product names
ads using our name in the public Ad Library
new domains similar to ours
tickets about orders we cannot find

steps: Search the Ad Library and new domains for our name and close spellings
Match against tickets about unknown orders
A person confirms each fake with screenshots
File takedowns and log the date
Warn customers with a short note on the site if the fake is spreading
jobs.output: a weekly impersonation list with takedowns filed and outcomes

watch.metric: lookalike domains and fake ads using our brand found and taken down
watch.source: Meta Ad Library and domain check

jobs.drives: customers cheated in our name

jobs.job: Set email authentication on our sending domain to the strict setting in 3 steps over 6 weeks, so nobody can send fake order emails in our name
jobs.trigger: once, then checked monthly

inputs.need: DNS access for the sending domain
every tool that sends mail as us (email tool, helpdesk, store)
a free report reader for the domain

steps: List every tool that sends as our domain and add each to the records
Set the policy to monitor and read reports for 2 weeks
Move to quarantine for 2 weeks, then to reject
Check real emails still land in inboxes at each step
jobs.output: sending domain at the strict setting with every real sender passing

watch.metric: sending domains with email authentication at the strict setting

jobs.drives: fake emails reaching customers, and inbox placement

jobs.job: List every script on checkout and payment pages, check each against the approved list after any new app install, and remove any that can read card fields
jobs.trigger: monthly, and on the day any app is added

inputs.need: scripts loaded on cart, checkout and thank you pages
installed apps and their permissions
approved script list

steps: Scan cart and checkout pages and list every script and where it loads from
Match each to an approved app
Flag unknown scripts and any with access to card fields
Remove or ask the vendor, and log the change
jobs.output: an approved script list and a monthly diff with any unknown script removed

watch.metric: scripts on checkout and payment pages not on the approved list

jobs.drives: card data stolen through our store

new_enablers.name: Fraud and dispute watch
new_enablers.what: Tracks disputes against the processor's warning line, risky orders to hold, discount codes used beyond plan, card testing bursts and customers with high claim costs. Keeps templates for each dispute reason and the monthly cost of fraud.

new_enablers.name: Bot and fake traffic filter
new_enablers.what: Scores sessions, add to carts, clicks and sign-ups for bot signs by source, page and hour, and shows conversion and cost with the fake part removed.
powers: test reads not spoiled by bots

new_enablers.name: Backup and incident kit
new_enablers.what: Daily backups with timed restore drills, a 1 page incident plan with the first 5 steps and who to call, the Meta takeover plan, and the peak readiness checklist.
powers: calm first hour of an incident
